import numpy as np
import mujoco
from rcb_hb import Session
S=None

def init():
 global S
 S=Session('balance_simple',instance='/app/instance.npz')

def rollout(p,save=False):
 global S
 if S is None:init()
 s=S;d=s.data;s.reset();robot=s.low.task.robot
 lo=s.model.actuator_ctrlrange[:,0];span=np.diff(s.model.actuator_ctrlrange,axis=1)[:,0]
 p=np.asarray(p);base=np.zeros(19);base[[2,7]]=p[0];base[[3,8]]=p[1];base[[4,9]]=p[2]
 base[[1,6]]=p[3]
 G=p[5:23].reshape(3,6);H=p[23:29];damp=p[4]
 total=0;acts=[];metrics=[]
 for t in range(1000):
  com=d.subtree_com[1]; v=d.sensordata[0:3] # use explicit robot sensor below
  v=robot.center_of_mass_velocity()
  mat=d.xmat[12].reshape(3,3); pitch=np.arctan2(mat[0,2],mat[2,2]);roll=-np.arctan2(mat[1,2],mat[2,2])
  bm=d.xmat[23].reshape(3,3);bp=np.arctan2(bm[0,2],bm[2,2]);br=-np.arctan2(bm[1,2],bm[2,2])
  # orientation rates from root and board angular velocities
  x=np.array([com[0],v[0],pitch,d.qvel[4],bp,d.qvel[29]])
  y=np.array([com[1],v[1],roll,d.qvel[3],br,d.qvel[28]])
  u=base.copy();f=G@x;u[[2,7]]+=f[0];u[[3,8]]+=f[1];u[[4,9]]+=f[2];u[[1,6]]+=H@y
  u[:10]-=damp*d.qvel[6:16]
  a=np.clip(2*(u-lo)/span-1,-1,1).astype(np.float32)
  if save:acts.append(a)
  _,_,done=s.step(a)
  speed=np.linalg.norm(v[:2]);up=robot.torso_upright();head=robot.head_height();eff=np.mean(d.actuator_force**2)
  upright=np.clip((up-.8)/.2,0,1)*np.clip((head-1.65)/.37,0,1)
  still=np.exp(-(speed/.45)**2)
  reward=upright*still*(.8+.2*np.exp(-eff/10000))
  val=1+reward-.3*np.linalg.norm(com[:2])-.1*(abs(bp)+abs(br))
  total+=val
  if save:metrics.append([head,up,speed,eff,com[0],com[1],bp,br,reward])
  if done:break
 if save:return total,np.asarray(acts),np.asarray(metrics),s.status()
 return -total
